ValidationRule.description: Complete the voucher state and email audit details.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Complete the voucher state and email audit details.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Redeemed"), OR(ISBLANK(Redeemed_At__c), ISBLANK(Redeemed_By__c), ISBLANK(Service_Location__c), ISBLANK(Service_Order_Number__c))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Cancelled"), OR(ISBLANK(Cancelled_At__c), ISBLANK(Cancellation_Reason__c))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Email_Status__c, "Sent"), ISBLANK(Email_Sent_At__c)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Email_Status__c, "Error"), ISBLANK(Email_Error__c)))
